acquisition method: MS and MS/MS data were obtained using the TOP10 method.
cleavage agent: digested with TPCK-treated trypsin (Worthington Biochemical Corporation, US).
enrichment method: Total soluble proteins from MaSp1 nuc and MaSp1 pla lines were His-trap purified
fractionation method: resolved on SDS-PAGE gels (4%–20% Mini-PROTEAN TGX, Bio-Rad, US).
instrument: Q Exactive Hybrid Quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
applied to a Q Exactive Hybrid Quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, US).
labeling: Bands corresponding to 25 kDa and 50 kDa for MaSp1pla and 25 kDa for MaSp1nuc were excised, destained, and digested with TPCK-treated trypsin
ptm: Acetyl (Protein N-term); Gln- > pyro-Glu (N-term Q); Oxidation (M); Propionamide (C)
variable modifications = Acetyl (Protein N-term), Gln- > pyro-Glu (N-term Q), Oxidation (M), Propionamide (C)
